title: Advance an item's acceptance basis only when its acceptance changes, so a label edit no longer stales recorded evaluations
outcome: Advance an item's acceptance basis only when its acceptance changes, so a label edit no longer stales recorded evaluations
acceptance: Adding or removing a label (for example ready-to-land) leaves the item's acceptance_basis unchanged, and an acceptance evaluation recorded before the label edit stays current for done
Changing acceptance criteria, bindings or the evaluation mode still advances acceptance_basis and stales earlier evaluations, as today
A behavior test shows both cases through the public words (update with a label, then show and done), with no change to stored record ids or links
